concerns.text: The plan derives `prime_valence` and `stimulus_ambiguity` scores using lexical dictionaries and a CPU‑only emotion classifier (see step 3 of the plan and §3.2 of research.md) but provides no external validation of these derived measures. Without independent verification that the scores accurately reflect true valence and ambiguity, the subsequent hypothesis test (H1/H2) may be confounded, limiting the interpretability of any observed association between derived scores and response times.
